description: make train's stages (the Makefile's $(TRAIN_DIR)/<stage>.done targets) for the training dashboard: each stage's group, what it runs on (cpu, or gpu - one at a time under the GPU lock), the stages it needs (data dependencies), the stages it runs after (ordering only - Make's order-only prerequisites: the CPU checks scheduled into the voice's GPU-bound hours), its expected minutes (an M3 Max on its 140 W adapter, measured 2026-11-02 and, the voice stages, 2026-11-05 - with the perceptual loss; the training speech cached) and, for a stage that makes the training speech, its firstMinutes (the minutes when the run makes it: the firstRun stage's log's latest firstRun line counts clips to make), a stage without a training run whose log counts its progress (progress: {log - in $(TRAIN_DIR), pattern - a finished part's line, total - its parts}, or {phases - its own log's commands' phases in order: each one's name, header - a line with its count of items to do (the first capture; none - none to do), step - a line with its items done, of its total, in its seconds so far, secondsEach - its expected seconds an item, sameCount - a later phase whose count is the phase before's}), the training run it writes ($(TRAIN_DIR)/runs/<run>/ - its train/data/train.json section, whose stop ends it early), and for a listening samples stage, the stage whose model it renders (samples - $(TRAIN_DIR)/samples/index.json's stage; reference: the shipped model); test/testTrainStages.js keeps it in sync with the Makefile

stages.title: The training speech - the local TTS model's clips and their CTC alignment (picovox_train.tts generate, align - once: about 40 and 18 minutes the first time, a minute cached)

phases.name: align
phases.header: ^tts align: \d+ clips, (?:(\d+) to align|the alignment is current)$

stages.title: The heteronym tokens' readings, measured (picovox_train.measure - once), and the clips they change aligned again

phases.name: align
phases.header: ^tts align: \d+ clips, (?:(\d+) to align|the alignment is current)$

stages.title: The voices' training data (picovox_train.tts build - every core; cached with the training speech, built when its inputs change)

phases.name: build
phases.header: ^tts build: (?:(\d+) clips to build|.* is current)

stages.title: The heteronym relabeling from the training speech's readings, checked to reproduce train/data/g2p-relabel.json (the G2P network's input)
The G2P network's four stages (picovox_train.g2p train - one core, deterministic)
The heteronym context labels (the pinned books, the training speech's measured readings, part-of-speech tags)
The context network and its cross-validation - fold 0 the network itself - and the cross-validated held-out gate (picovox_train.context train-context, folds)
The G2P's reading stage - the reading input and the ambiguity head (picovox_train.context train-g2p - two threads, beside the context network)
The context G2P's export and its gate (picovox_train.context export, check: identical to the committed module below its header, else within the recipe's tolerances)
The voice's stage A (picovox_train.trainmulti --recipe voice.a - 15,000 steps)
The voice's stage B with the critic (picovox_train.trainmulti --recipe voice.b - 10,000 steps)

The shipped model (lib/models/voiceModel.js) through the listener panel - its word error rate and its gap to the training speech, the gate's baseline (picovox_train.panel eval - once per shipped model, cached with the training speech)
The voice through the listener panel - its word error rate and its gap to the training speech - and the gate (picovox_train.panel gate: within the tolerance of the shipped model)
The voice's module, TRAIN_DIR/voiceModel.js - the export the gate scored, with its provenance (picovox_train.package)
Stage A's samples - its final checkpoint (tools/trainsamples.js)
Stage B's samples - its best checkpoint, the model the package stage packages (tools/trainsamples.js)
